condition.en: The pawn in front of the king captures any enemy piece.
condition.ro: Pionul din fata regelui captureaza orice piesa inamica.

effect.en: Becomes a MightyPawn: captures sideways, gives check sideways, never promotes. On the last rank it unlocks full mobility.
effect.ro: Devine MightyPawn: captureaza lateral, da sah lateral, nu promoveaza niciodata. Pe ultima linie capata mobilitate completa.

condition.en: The pawns on the a, c, f and h files are blocked in front for 2 consecutive turns.
condition.ro: Pionii de pe coloanele a, c, f si h sunt blocati frontal 2 ture consecutive.

effect.en: They can make a single one-square sideways step.
effect.ro: Pot face o singura data un pas lateral de un patrat.

condition.en: No condition, but you start with 7 pawns: the missing one is chosen at random.
condition.ro: Fara conditie, dar incepi cu 7 pioni: cel lipsa e ales aleator.

effect.en: In exchange, every pawn can advance 2 squares at any time, not only from the start rank.
effect.ro: In schimb, toti pionii pot avansa 2 patrate oricand, nu doar de pe randul de start.

condition.en: A pawn reaches rank 6.
condition.ro: Un pion ajunge pe linia 6.

effect.en: It may promote there, but only to a knight or bishop. Promotion is optional: it can continue to rank 8 for a queen.
effect.ro: Poate promova acolo, dar doar in cal sau nebun. Promovarea e optionala: poate continua spre linia 8 pentru dama.

condition.en: None. Every pawn starts with its retreat available.
condition.ro: Niciuna. Fiecare pion se naste cu retragerea disponibila.

effect.en: Each pawn can step back one square, once per game. The retreat cannot capture.
effect.ro: Fiecare pion poate merge inapoi un patrat, o singura data in partida. Retragerea nu captureaza.

condition.en: A pawn captures something that is not a pawn.
condition.ro: Un pion captureaza o piesa care nu e pion.

effect.en: It borrows the captured piece's shape until its next move. Moving that way tires it for one turn and it becomes a pawn again - but it can borrow another shape later.
effect.ro: Imprumuta forma piesei luate pana la urmatoarea lui mutare. Daca se misca asa, oboseste o tura si redevine pion - dar poate lua alta forma mai tarziu.

condition.en: The same knight moves on 3 consecutive own turns, without returning to a square it already visited.
condition.ro: Acelasi cal se muta 3 ture proprii consecutive, fara sa revina pe un patrat deja vizitat.

effect.en: Catches fire for one round: its next move burns 3 squares along the path, allies included. The fire threat counts as check.
effect.ro: Ia foc o runda: urmatoarea mutare arde 3 patrate de pe traseu, aliati inclusi. Amenintarea de foc conteaza ca sah.

condition.en: The same knight captures 2 pieces without being captured.
condition.ro: Acelasi cal captureaza 2 piese fara sa fie capturat.

effect.en: Once every 3 turns it can make a "long L" (3+1), in addition to its normal moves.
effect.ro: O data la 3 ture poate face un "L lung" (3+1), pe langa mutarile normale.

condition.en: The same knight captures 3 pieces.
condition.ro: Acelasi cal captureaza 3 piese.

effect.en: Once per game, two knight jumps in a single turn. The first must land on an empty square; the second may capture.
effect.ro: O singura data, doua sarituri de cal intr-o tura. Prima trebuie sa aterizeze pe gol; a doua poate captura.

condition.en: The same bishop captures two medium pieces (knight, bishop, rook) or one queen. Only one bishop can become an Archbishop.
condition.ro: Acelasi nebun captureaza doua piese medii (cal, nebun, turn) sau o dama. Doar un singur nebun poate deveni Archbishop.

effect.en: Permanent: moves diagonally like a bishop, plus the knight's L move.
effect.ro: Permanent: se misca pe diagonale ca un nebun, plus mutare in L ca un cal.

condition.en: Once every 3 of your own turns. The recharge starts counting from move one.
condition.ro: O data la 3 ture proprii. Reincarcarea porneste de la inceputul partidei.

effect.en: The bishop steps one square sideways, left or right, onto an empty square. That is how it changes the colour it travels on.
effect.ro: Nebunul face un pas lateral, stanga sau dreapta, pe un patrat gol. Asa isi schimba culoarea patratelor pe care se misca.

condition.en: The bishop captures a piece worth more than itself: a rook or a queen.
condition.ro: Nebunul captureaza o piesa mai valoroasa decat el: un turn sau o dama.

effect.en: A chain of captures along the same diagonal, in the same direction, however long. It stops at a friendly piece or a king.
effect.ro: Lant de capturi pe aceeasi diagonala, in acelasi sens, oricat de lung. Se opreste la o piesa proprie sau la un rege.

condition.en: The rook captures a piece, then stays still for 3 consecutive own turns.
condition.ro: Turnul captureaza o piesa, apoi sta nemiscat 3 ture proprii consecutive.

effect.en: Gains a shield: the first attack takes the shield instead of killing it, and the attacker stays put. Repeatable.
effect.ro: Primeste un scut: primul atac ii ia scutul in loc sa il omoare, iar atacatorul ramane pe loc. Se poate reface.

condition.en: The rook makes at least one move, then stays still for 3 consecutive own turns.
condition.ro: Turnul face cel putin o mutare, apoi sta nemiscat 3 ture proprii consecutive.

effect.en: Raises a wall over up to 3 horizontal squares. It blocks any line, even a check. While it is up, the rook cannot move.
effect.ro: Ridica un zid pe pana la 3 patrate orizontale. Blocheaza orice linie, chiar si un sah. Cat e activ, turnul nu se poate misca.

condition.en: Once every 7 of your own turns.
condition.ro: O data la 7 ture proprii.

effect.en: The rook raises its shield instead of moving. Whoever tries to take it dies instead. Lasts one round.
effect.ro: Turnul isi ridica scutul si nu se misca. Cine incearca sa il ia moare in locul lui. Tine o runda.

condition.en: Available from the start, once per game.
condition.ro: Disponibila de la inceput, o singura data pe joc.

effect.en: The queen returns instantly to her start square, if it is free. An escape, not a power.
effect.ro: Dama se intoarce instant pe patratul ei de start, daca e liber. Mecanica de salvare, nu de putere.

condition.en: The queen captures 3 pieces.
condition.ro: Dama captureaza 3 piese.

effect.en: Once, she can jump over exactly one piece blocking her.
effect.ro: O singura data, poate sari peste exact o piesa care o blocheaza.

condition.en: No condition: the counter runs from the start of the game.
condition.ro: Nu are conditie: contorul curge de la inceputul partidei.

effect.en: Every 10 own turns a new pawn appears in front of her. If the square is taken, the spawn is missed and the counter restarts.
effect.ro: La fiecare 10 ture proprii apare un pion nou in fata ei. Daca patratul e ocupat, spawn-ul se rateaza si contorul reporneste.

condition.en: None. It switches on by itself while your king is in check.
condition.ro: Niciuna. Se aprinde singura cat timp regele tau e in sah.

effect.en: While the king is in check, the queen also moves like a knight. It goes out the moment the check is answered.
effect.ro: Cat regele e in sah, dama se misca si ca un cal. Se stinge in clipa in care sahul e parat.

condition.en: The king captures a piece in person.
condition.ro: Regele captureaza personal o piesa.

effect.en: Once per game, it can move 2 squares in a straight line, without passing through check. It CANNOT castle.
effect.ro: O data pe joc, se poate misca 2 patrate in linie dreapta, fara sa treaca prin sah. NU poate face rocada.

condition.en: Has already castled once.
condition.ro: A facut deja o rocada.

effect.en: The only king that can castle. It can also castle a second time, on the opposite side, if that rook has not moved and the path is clear.
effect.ro: Singurul rege care poate face rocada. Poate face si a doua rocada, pe partea opusa, daca turnul de acolo nu s-a miscat si drumul e liber.

condition.en: Once every 10 of your own turns. It recharges.
condition.ro: O data la 10 ture proprii. Se reincarca.

effect.en: Swaps places with any friendly piece on the board, however far away.
effect.ro: Schimb de locuri cu orice piesa aliata de pe tabla, oricat de departe.
